features: Local Liquid Glass refraction from supplied reference, reduced 4px blur and shared header controls.
Mobile dark animation with reduced-motion and WebGL fallback; compact nonzero gift chips.
Native Arange Noise/TCP and KCP/UDP carrier; BackPack Noise/TCP and KCP/UDP carrier.
Pinned source installers for Arange, BackPack, Dragon Fruit Relay, Doctor DNS and HyperDNS.
Per-account, per-node subscriber DNS endpoints, AJAX diagnostics and private Apple DNS profiles.

validation.notes: Arange KCP UDP VPN forwarding failed and is explicitly rejected. KCP TCP VPN forwarding passed.
static_checks: five pinned source archive hashes and safe extraction
validation.browser: not verified: cloud browser could not reach local QA server

limitations: Visual browser and live clean-VPS installation were not verified in this environment.
One managed paired tunnel per host. Source compilation needs internet access and temporary build resources.
Arange KCP mode is restricted to TCP VPN targets; Noise and BackPack support tested TCP/UDP targets.
Dragon Fruit Relay uses its own dedicated Debian routing setup, not Beeny pairing/profile generation.
Doctor DNS/HyperDNS require a dedicated host. Upstream subscriber creation, quotas and renewals remain manual; Beeny stores per-account endpoints and delivers profiles.
No automatic migration of existing imported VPN profiles; download again after listener/endpoint changes.
Reachability between hosts and permitted provider firewall ports are required; transport does not guarantee resistance to filtering.
No Microsoft Defender approval or fresh malware scan is claimed for 3.7.2.
